# Lab 5.8: Remote Functions with Cloud Run

## What We Are Going to Do
Deploy a small Cloud Run function and call it from SQL as a BigQuery remote function.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Write and deploy the function.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">mkdir -p remote_fn &amp;&amp; cd remote_fn
cat &gt; main.py &lt;&lt;'EOF'
import functions_framework, json

@functions_framework.http
def handler(request):
    calls = request.get_json()["calls"]
    replies = [f"{c[0]} ({len(c[0])} chars)" if c[0] is not None else None for c in calls]
    return json.dumps({"replies": replies})
EOF
echo "functions-framework==3.*" &gt; requirements.txt
gcloud functions deploy describe-text --gen2 --runtime=python312 --region=us-central1 \
  --source=. --entry-point=handler --trigger-http --no-allow-unauthenticated
cd ..
FN_URL=$(gcloud functions describe describe-text --region=us-central1 --format="value(serviceConfig.uri)")
echo $FN_URL</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[CLI] Create a Cloud resource connection and let it call the function.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq mk --connection --connection_type=CLOUD_RESOURCE --location=US lab_conn
CONN_SA=$(bq show --format=json --connection $PROJECT_ID.us.lab_conn | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['cloudResource']['serviceAccountId'])")
gcloud run services add-iam-policy-binding describe-text --region=us-central1 \
  --member=serviceAccount:$CONN_SA --role=roles/run.invoker</span>
</code></pre>
</div>

5. **[Console] See the batching.** Open **Cloud Run → describe-text → Logs**. Each request carries up to 50 rows in `calls`.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Contract | Request `{"calls": [...]}`, response `{"replies": [...]}` |
| Auth | Connection service account has `run.invoker` |
| Batching | Up to 50 rows per HTTP call |
| Keep | `us.lab_conn` is reused in later modules |
